m3_text_verbatim:
M3: DP-SGD and convergence hardening, $2,000 & ~4 weeks

Integrate Opacus for DP-SGD and make the noise multiplier, clipping bound, and related hyperparameters configurable, with published utility-versus-privacy curves so a group can pick its own setting from real numbers. Harden the consensus-distance tracking into proper divergence detection that flags a run going bad while it can still be retuned.

Deliverable: tunable DP-SGD working end to end, published tradeoff curves, divergence detection.
distinctions: Four weeks and $2,000 are proposal estimates/grant amount, not benchmark acceptance thresholds.
Published utility-versus-privacy curves are an explicit deliverable; local evidence preparation does not prove publication.
No minimum language-model accuracy, maximum perplexity, maximum epsilon or allowable accuracy loss is stated for M3.
M4 library distribution, external user and multi-region demo requirements are not M3 exit criteria.
